changelog: Big update. NEW: Posted tracking (auto-marks when you Post Now, plus All/To Post/Posted filters and a manual toggle). Facebook Scout — checks your listings by stock # to see what's posted, what needs relisting, and can auto-renew stale listings. D2C whole-list import (Pre-owned / Not published) straight into your inventory. Days-on-lot shown per car with a warning under 25 days, sort by days on lot, and a Last-scan timestamp in the header.
